deletion.confirm: Access is blocked immediately on all devices. The account and saved data await permanent deletion after a {days}-day grace period. The server calculated this preview at {calculated}, Swedish time: the grace period would end {eligible} and the first planned run would be {run}. The grace period begins when scheduling completes after your confirmation code. The dates are recalculated then and the actual times appear in the account details. The job runs daily at 04:00 UTC; this is no guarantee that deletion will be complete then. A pending address change is permanently cancelled. Deletion cannot be undone here.
deletion.previewLoading: Reading the account's current status and a new preview from the server before you can confirm deletion.
deletion.previewUnavailable: Deletion cannot be confirmed without a current preview. Close the dialog and open it again to reload account status.
deletion.receipt: Deletion of {email} scheduled {deleted}. Access is blocked.
deletion.pending: Grace period ends <nowrap>{eligible}</nowrap>. First planned run <nowrap>{run}</nowrap>, Swedish time. Deletion is not complete yet.
deletion.alreadyPending: The account already awaits deletion. Its date has not changed.
deletion.unknown: We cannot confirm whether deletion was scheduled.
deletion.deliveryUnavailable: No confirmation code could be sent. Deletion has not been scheduled.
